alignment: Reuse left-anchored complete bilateral 120-point/30-step 60Hz windows; skip incomplete right inputs, no interpolation or re-anchoring.
fitting: Same fixed TRAIN14 participant folds as bilateral v1; same RF configuration and TRAIN pooled OOF threshold rule. Fresh matched 66-feature control and 78-feature candidate. No new loss, history, hyperparameter search, gating or postprocessing.
lock_policy: Lock feature definitions, models, thresholds and source before separate readonly VALIDATION4 evaluation; no new TEST windows or scores.
development_gate: Candidate must have higher matched-window F1, no greater raw false alarm seconds, no lower raw FoG-time recall and no lower decision support than matched control. Passing is development evidence only, not automatic default adoption or independent generalization.
